en.answer: When resolving the effect of <<11634>>, due to the effect of <<6682>>, the "Burning Abyss" Spell/Trap Card you choose from your Deck is banished instead of sent to the Graveyard.
en.question: If <<6682>> is chained to the effect of <<11634>> that sends a "Burning Abyss" Spell/Trap Card from my Deck to the Graveyard, how does its effect resolve?
